title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid)

About this role

Toast is shifting from B2B powerhouse to consumer innovator. We're using our restaurant and guest data to make dining feel personal and frictionless, and with AI in the mix, we want discovery, booking, and dining to feel genuinely memorable.

You'll own reservations and booking end to end, from the messy, undefined version of the problem to the pixels that ship. Booking looks simple on the surface. It isn't. Making it feel easy is what this role is all about. You'll flex across other consumer surfaces when we need you there. 

You'd join a small, ambitious Consumer Design team that feels and operates like a startup within a larger company.  We have autonomy and the runway to reimagine dining and we all love to roll our sleeves up and jam together.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

Thinking

• Take an ambiguous problem and come back with a point of view and a prototype

• Design the whole loop, not just the booking screen

• Hold both sides in your head. A guest booking a table and a restaurant running a floor want different things

• Use behavioral data and guest feedback to shape what's next

Prototyping

• Build working prototypes fast, in whatever tool gets you there (Figma Make, Cursor, Replit, Magic Patterns, Lovable)

• Get something testable in front of people within days. Rough is fine, invisible isn't

• Run small experiments and think in phases

Craft

• Own visual and interaction quality end to end. Real opinions on type, spacing, hierarchy, motion

• Design native mobile and responsive web that holds up against the best apps people use

• Contribute to our design systems

Working together

• Partner closely with product, eng, research, and marketing

• Raise the bar for the designers around you through crit and pairing (not a management role, but a senior one)

• Advocate for the guest even when the pressure runs the other way, and explain why in terms the business cares about

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 5 to 7+ years designing consumer or consumer-grade products, with shipped work in your portfolio

• Range across native and responsive, guest-facing and operator-facing

• Bonus for scheduling, availability, transactional, or marketplace flow experience, or anything where a guest action has to land cleanly in someone else's operations

• Fluency with AI prototyping tools and Figma, with a strong handle on accessibility

• Solid UX fundamentals and the judgment to know which one a problem needs

How you use AI

We use these tools constantly, and we're specific about why. We want work that's better because of how you use AI: sharper concepts, more options explored, more of the unglamorous states actually designed. You know where it helps and where it produces confident mush.

Nice to haves

• You design in code, or close enough that engineers trust your handoff

• You've built or stewarded a design system

• You've shipped consumer at scale and know what breaks there

• Front-end and performance literacy. You know why your beautiful transition is dropping frames

• You're a tinkerer. You build things nobody asked for just to see if they'd work

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.
The Role
BPX is hiring a Senior CDP Solutions Architect into our Intelligent Marketing practice. You will own the technical design of customer data platform programmes for enterprise clients - from data model and identity strategy through to segmentation, activation and journey orchestration. This is a hands-on architecture role, not a slide-deck one: you run discovery with client marketing, data and IT teams, define the target-state architecture, and stay close enough to the build to unblock engineers and prove the design works in production. Twilio Segment and Adobe Real-Time CDP are our primary platforms, with Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360) and adjacent tooling on a growing number of engagements. On every programme you lead, you are the client-facing technical authority.
What you'll do

• Lead discovery and requirements workshops with client marketing, data and IT stakeholders, translating commercial goals into CDP use cases.

• Design target-state CDP architecture: data models and schemas, ingestion patterns, identity resolution and profile strategy, consent and governance.

• Architect and oversee integrations between the CDP and CRM, cloud data platforms, analytics, paid media and messaging systems.

• Define segmentation and activation approaches across batch, streaming and edge, chosen on use case and data readiness rather than habit.

• Design cross-channel journey orchestration and hand activation-ready audiences to campaign teams.

• Stay hands-on - build proofs of concept, review engineering work, and clear technical blockers during delivery.

• Own data quality, privacy and compliance standards, including GDPR and consent management, across every implementation.

• Mentor CDP engineers and consultants, and contribute to BPX delivery accelerators, patterns and reusable assets.

• Support pre-sales with scoping, estimation, solution shaping and technical credibility in client pitches.

What you'll bring

• Certification in Twilio Segment CDP and Adobe Real-Time CDP - both are required for this role.

• Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360) certification is a distinct advantage, as are certifications in other customer data or engagement platforms.

• Seven or more years in martech or customer data, including at least three years architecting CDP implementations end to end.

• Deep hands-on command of schema and data modelling, identity resolution, audience segmentation and activation at enterprise scale.

• Strong SQL, plus working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure or AWS) and API-based integration.

• Experience integrating CDPs with CRM and journey orchestration tooling such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze.

• Practical grasp of GDPR, ePrivacy

title: Staff Software Engineer - HyperScale Build Platform and Tools
description:

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The Hyperscale Line of Business builds and ships products to hyperscale customers at exabyte scale, with an emphasis on speed, reliability, and operational excellence. The Build Platform and Tools team owns the developer productivity infrastructure (build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments) that every engineer in the organization depends on daily to build and test software.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for that platform and to solve its hardest problems. You’ll define the multi-year architecture for build infrastructure across the Hyperscale org, lead the highest-ambiguity technical work yourself, and raise the engineering bar of the teams around you. Your success is measured less by what you personally ship than by how much faster the entire Hyperscale engineering organization moves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the technical vision and multi-year architecture for build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments across the Hyperscale Line of Business

• Make and document the consequential architectural decisions: build system selection and migration, remote execution and caching strategy, hermeticity and reproducibility guarantees, and the tradeoffs each imposes on developers

• Drive step-change improvements to build speed, reliability, reproducibility, debuggability, and ease of use across local development and CI workflows

• Solve large-scale C/C++ build challenges at their root: dependency graph decomposition and pruning, static/dynamic linking tradeoffs, toolchain and sysroot management, and incremental correctness

• Diagnose and eliminate whole classes of build-graph correctness issues, flaky builds, and incremental-build regressions rather than individual instances

• Define the standards for containerized build environments - consistent, isolated, reproducible images with a clear lifecycle and upgrade path

• Partner with the engineering manager to shape the team’s roadmap, sequence investments, and make explicit tradeoffs between platform work and near-term product delivery

• Influence and align engineering leaders and teams across Hyperscale and the broader organization on tooling direction, migration plans, and shared standards.

• Set the operational excellence bar for build infrastructure: observability, incident response, change management, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.

• Establish the engineering metrics that define developer experience, and use them to justify investment and demonstrate impact

• Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, review designs across the team, and grow the technical depth of the organization in build systems and developer productivity

• Represent the team in org-wide technical forums, design reviews, and planning; act as the recognized expert on build infrastructure.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: Test Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.

- Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding.

- Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization.

- Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods.

- Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions.

- Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced.

title: Senior Manager, Fraud Strategy & Operations
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Fraud and Risk Operations team safeguards Raisin’s U.S. business by monitoring, detecting, and mitigating risks across the customer lifecycle. We manage fraud prevention, investigations, payments risk, fraud recovery, and while supporting 2nd line AML/KYC oversight. It partners closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Customer Service to ensure safe and frictionless customer experiences. As a multi-bank deposit marketplace targeting rapid growth, Raisin faces complex, evolving multi-vector fraud challenges across onboarding, identity verification, bank linking, and money movement. Fraud and Risk Operations is at the center of designing the strategies, controls, and analytical foundations that protect the platform at scale.

Your Responsibilities

This role directly reports to the Head of Fraud Operations and is a senior expert role at Raisin US. We are looking for a Fraud Operations Specialist to assist in the design, building, and optimizing our fraud prevention and detection framework. In this role, you will be responsible for creating both predictive (pre-transaction/real-time mitigation) and detective (post-transaction/monitoring) rules within our risk platform. You will analyze emerging fraud patterns, balance fraud mitigation with user friction, and collaborate with product, engineering, payments, service and other allied teams to protect the Raisin platform and its customers while optimizing transaction approval rates.

Predictive & Preventative Strategy (Real-Time Rules)

• Real-Time Rule Authoring: Design, test, and deploy real-time logic within the risk rules engine (e.g., velocity checks, device fingerprinting triggers, IP risk thresholds, and behavioral anomalies, etc.) to intercept fraudulent actions during the entire customer lifecycle.

• Risk Model Integration: Partner with internal and external platform partners to integrate, build and implement both customer and transaction level fraud scores into the rules engine, creating conditional logic that automatically approves, blocks, or challenges high-risk events.

• Friction Optimization: Monitor and optimize false positive rates to ensure legitimate customer transactions pass through with minimal friction.

Detective & Post-Transaction Strategy (Monitoring & Analysis)

• Behavioral & Batch Monitoring: Build detective monitoring rules, threshold alerts, and transaction reports to identify complex fraud patterns, first party fraud triggers, account takeover, synthetic ID, or coordinated fraud rings after events occur.

• Chargeback & Loss Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct post-mortems on confirmed fraud instances and Reg E disputes to identify gaps in existing rule sets and rapidly deploy backtest-verified countermeasures.

• Rule Performance Tuning: Regularly review, backtest, and refine active rules to eliminate stale logic, reduce redundancy, and adapt to shifting fraud tactics. Utilize the iterations of rules to also actively monitor the existing customer book. 

• Rules and telemetry expansion: Active work internally and externally to seek additional risk signals, and proactively deploy to stay ahead of emerging fraud patterns.

Fraud Strategy & Operations

title: KC-135 Pilot
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.  

Position Summary

Metrea is actively recruiting current and qualified Contract KC-135 Pilots-in-Command (PIC’s) and Second in Command (SIC’s) to execute high tempo, precision driven air to air refueling missions aboard our KC/C-135 fleet. This is not just another contract; it’s a chance to lead strategic operations that shape global airpower.  If you’re ready to fuel the fight, lead from the front, and fly with purpose this may be your next mission!

Contract Highlights:

• Flexible short- and long-term deployments supporting U.S. and allied forces are available and extended rotations of 45-90 days, delivering critical refueling support in a high-demand regional environments in India.

• Competitive daily rates and mission incentives.

• All travel, lodging, and mission logistics covered.

• Flexible scheduling and rotation options.

• Work alongside elite crews in high-impact missions that shape global readiness.

 

What You'll Do

• Command flight crew while responding to a variety of emergency and non-emergency scenarios.

• Conduct procedurally correct and expeditious pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight inspections, checklists, and documentation. 

• Maintain Situational Awareness (SA) and use Crew Resource Management (CRM) throughout all phases of flight.

• Adhere to company Flight Operation Procedures (FOPs), Ground Operation Procedures (GOPs), FAA regulations, and Safety Notices.

• Maintain all currencies, qualifications, and advanced systems knowledge related to the KC/C-135 tanker fleet.

• All other duties assigned

What You Bring

Education : 

• Bachelor’s degree required

Experience :

• 400 hours of flight time

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

The Data Center Operations team keeps Fluidstack's AI data centers running around the clock, operating the mechanical, electrical, and controls systems that keep gigawatt-scale infrastructure online for frontier AI workloads.

Examples of key problems the team is working on:

- Operate live chiller plants, CRAC/CRAH units, and direct-to-chip liquid cooling loops at densities where minutes of cooling loss mean thermal shutdown of GPU clusters.

title: Internship position for World Models for Software Architecture (Constructor Fabric)
description:
About the Project

Constructor Fabric turns a company's informal knowledge into production software through a pipeline of composable capability units called gears : requirements → architecture → product fit → framework (G1) → application → runtime. We are building a World Model over that pipeline - a model that does not just generate code, but predicts the consequences of an architectural decision: total cost of ownership, unintended side effects, latency and failure behaviour, and whether a proposed composition is even admissible.
The central object is not a digital twin of the application but its formal architectural skeleton : gear contracts (GearSpec), a typed attributed hypergraph of the application (AppGraph), a composition algebra that defines which assemblies are legal, and several semantic projections (types, protocols, resources, security) over which properties are proved, refuted by counterexample, or reported as an explainable gap . All of it is written in a domain-specific language whose syntax trees and graphs we keep in a projectional editor (JetBrains MPS) - so the DSL is not a convenience layer, it is the thing that defines the model's state space and the boundary of what the model is allowed to propose.

Internship Role

As a Research Intern (Machine Learning for Software Engineering), you will support the data and modelling work behind the World Model - mining code, building datasets, and running baseline experiments. We are looking for students who are keen to collaborate with industrial companies working with AI, open to out-of-the-box topics, and interested in a long-term collaboration.

The Ads ML Serving team is part of Reddit ’s Ads ML Platform, which builds the infrastructure and tools that power machine learning across Ads. This team focuses on creating a highly reliable, scalable, and efficient ML serving stack. Their work includes evolving long-term serving architecture, integrating closely with the ads serving stack, optimizing CPU/GPU performance, and building model velocity tools like observability libraries and model quality gating.

Here, diverse perspectives are seen as a core strength, fostering a team dynamic where everyone feels empowered to contribute and innovate. From ideation to delivery, our engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership of their projects, working closely in cross-functional collaboration with PMs, UX, and partner teams. This hands-on approach means every team member plays a direct and visible role in delivering high-impact, user-focused solutions for some of Reddit ’s most strategic advertisers.

title: Software Engineer - Payload Integrations
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Payload Integrations team owns everything that connects to the vehicle beyond the base platform. This includes gimbals and EO/IR sensors, arming and fuzing devices, weapons payloads, radios, and other mission hardware. We build the software and interfaces that enable these payloads to reliably run on the vehicle. Nearly every customer program needs a new or modified payload, which makes this team a critical contributor to nearly everything we ship. Our work goes from the lab bench to hardware-in-the-loop testing to live flight, and it has to work in a variety of demanding operational environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payload Integrations team. You will design, build, and maintain the software that brings new sensors, communications systems, and mission payloads onto our autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with hardware, electrical, autonomy, and systems engineering teams, as well as outside payload vendors, to turn new hardware into dependable, well-tested components of the vehicle. If you are self-motivated, hold yourself to high standards, enjoy working where software meets hardware, and do well in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Design and implement software integrations for gimbals, EO/IR sensors, radios, arming and fuzing devices, and other mission payloads on autonomous vehicles.

• Define and maintain clean, reusable interfaces between payloads and the vehicle software stack, to enable new payloads without changes to autonomy code.

• Work through vendor interface control documents (ICDs), implement device drivers and protocol handlers, and lead hardware bring-up in the lab.

• Build simulation, emulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test infrastructure to evaluate payload behavior before flight.

• Support integration events, ground tests, and flight tests, and root-cause issues across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries.

• Partner with program teams to scope, estimate, and deliver payload integrations for customer projects on tight timelines.

• Contribute to the safety-critical software behind arming and weapons-related payloads, with a high bar for rigor, review, and testing.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on embedded systems, robotics, or hardware integration.

• Strong experience with Rust and/or C++, plus working proficiency in Python.

• Hands-on experience integrating hardware over common interfaces and protocols (e.g., UART/RS-422, CAN, Ethernet/UDP, SPI/I2C).

• Experience reading datasheets and ICDs and turning them into robust software implementations.

• Comfort debugging at the hardware/software boundary using lab equipment and bus/packet analysis.

• Experience developing on Linux-based systems.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with external vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.

• US Persons: Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Engineering Manager
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY. title: Performance Marketing Specialist, Paid Search & Media
description:
About You

You’re a hands-on performance marketer who loves the detail of paid search. You’re equally comfortable building a Google search campaign from keywords to negatives and walking stakeholders through what the results mean. You bring rigor to QA, curiosity to testing, and the discipline to keep budgets on pace without losing sight of pipeline.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to lead our Google programs and run paid media across Search, YouTube, Display, DOOH, and LLMs.

Our buyers are ecommerce and retail leaders, and paid media is how many of them first hear from us. In this role, you’ll turn Sales and Demand Gen goals into campaigns that reach the right people at the right stage and build pipeline. You’ll own the channel end-to-end: planning, building, QAing, targeting, pacing, testing, reporting, and optimizing.

This is a hands-on, in-platform role. You’ll work alongside our Paid Social Specialist and partner closely with our Sales, Customer Marketing, Demand Gen, Creative, Product Marketing, and EMEA teams.

What makes this role different:

- You’ll own Google as a channel, not a slice of it. Planning, build, testing, and reporting all sit with you.

- You’ll work directly with Sales and Demand Gen, so you’ll see how your campaigns turn into pipeline.

- You’ll run a broad mix of channels, from Search and YouTube to DOOH and LLMs.

- You’ll lead weekly cross-channel optimization syncs, which gives you a voice in how the whole paid program performs.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Planning

- Plan, launch, and optimize ads for Google (Search/YouTube), Display, DOOH, and LLMs.

- Translate Sales and Demand Gen goals into plans by stage, persona, and segment.

- Shape copy and creative strategy with Creative, Customer Marketing, and Product Marketing, so each audience gets the right message.

Execution and Quality Assurance

- Build search campaigns end-to-end, including keyword strategy, match types, negative keywords, bidding, ad copy, audiences, and assets.

- Run rigorous QA across copy, assets, campaign structure, audiences, UTMs, and keywords before anything goes live.

- Partner with our EMEA team to localize global campaigns for their markets.

- Track tasks, requests, and SLAs in Asana so work stays visible and on schedule.

Audience Targeting and Management

- Own audience list hygiene and targeting across platforms.

- Build audiences from first- and third-party data.

- Manage pixels and primary vs. secondary conversion architecture, so campaigns optimize toward the actions that matter most.

title: ePayments Representative
description:
Overview
Ocean Bank is seeking an ePayments Representative to support the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of electronic banking transactions. This role performs essential operational and administrative activities involving ACH payments, wire transfers, mobile remote deposits, personalized bill payments, reconciliations, and customer support.
Responsibilities

• Process, balance, reconcile, and monitor customer-initiated electronic transactions within established deadlines.

• Support ACH processing, returns, prenotifications, Positive Pay exceptions, and U.S. Treasury reclamations.

• Monitor outgoing online banking wire transfers and complete required verification and approval steps.

• Process mobile remote deposits, personalized bill payments, and loan payment maintenance requests.

• Investigate discrepancies, resolve transaction issues, and respond to customers and Relationship Managers.

• Maintain operational reports and supporting documentation while following dual-control, segregation-of-duties, and approval requirements.

• Identify and escalate suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity in accordance with Bank policy.

Qualifications
Education/Experience:
Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• 2+ years’ experience in banking operations, preferably involving ACH processing, wire transfers, electronic payments, and bill payment services. Combination of education and experience will be considered.
Skills and Competencies

• Working knowledge of accounting principles, bank reconciliations, and general ledger systems.
• Knowledge of electronic banking operations, including ACH, wire transfers, bill payments, and mobile remote deposits.
• Working knowledge of, or ability to learn, applicable payment and banking regulations and rules, including NACHA Operating Rules, Regulation E, Regulation CC, and BSA/AML and OFAC requirements.
• Ability to assist customers with software-related issues and troubleshoot electronic banking problems by telephone.
• Ability to handle confidential financial information with discretion and professionalism.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow procedures and interpret instructions accurately.
• Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook. Preferences

• Associate’s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

• Bilingual (English and Spanish).

Licenses/Certifications

• None required; Accredited ACH Professional (AAP) designation preferred.

In this role you can work remote from Miami, Florida, United States Originally posted on Himalayas
